nodes.name: new_or_updated_file
nodes.title: New or Updated File
nodes.description: Trigger when a file is created or updated, checked on a schedule. Each event carries a Change Type of created or updated, and several edits between two checks arrive as a single event. Renaming a file counts as an update. Trashing a file is not an event, and neither is restoring one from the bin nor moving an existing file into the watched folder. Selecting a parent folder watches its direct child

parentFolder.description: [tuy chon dong cua piece] The Drive folder to target. Leave empty to use the root of My Drive. Type in the box to search your Drive by folder name. If the folder still isn't listed, switch this field to 'Dynamic value' (the toggle next to the field) and paste the folder ID — you can copy it from the folder's URL in Drive, after /folders/ (e.g. https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/<FOLDER_ID>).

include_team_drives.description: Determines if folders from Team Drives should be included in the results.

include_file_content.description: Include the file content in the output. This will increase the time taken to fetch the files and might cause issues with large files. If a download fails the event still arrives, carrying a File Content Error instead of the content.

nodes.name: notion_search
nodes.title: Search Pages and Databases
nodes.description: Searches the workspace by title for pages and/or databases shared with the integration, with exact or partial matching.

query.description: The title text (or part of it) to search for.

filter_type.description: Restrict results to pages, databases, or both. Defaults to both (all).

exact_match.description: When enabled, only return items whose title exactly equals the query. Disable for partial matching.

limit.description: How many items to return at most (between 1 and 100).

nodes.name: notion_query_database
nodes.title: Query Database
nodes.description: Queries a Notion database with the API's native filter and sort JSON objects (compound AND/OR, ranges, dates, contains, etc.).

database_id.description: The id of the database to query. Resolve a database title into its id with notion_search (filter_type=database).

filter.description: Optional. A Notion query filter object. A single condition is { "property": "Status", "status": { "equals": "Done" } }; compound is { "and": [ ...conditions ] } or { "or": [ ...conditions ] }. The condition key MUST match the property's type (e.g. status:{equals}, select:{equals}, number:{greater_than}, date:{on_or_after}, rich_text:{contains}, checkbox:{equals}). Run notion_get_database first to

sorts.description: Optional. An array of Notion sort objects. Sort by a property: [{ "property": "Name", "direction": "ascending" }]; sort by a timestamp: [{ "timestamp": "last_edited_time", "direction": "descending" }]. direction is "ascending" or "descending".

page_size.description: Maximum number of rows to return (1–100). Defaults to 100.

start_cursor.description: Optional pagination cursor. Pass the next_cursor returned by a previous call to fetch the next page of results.

nodes.name: notion_get_page
nodes.title: Get Page
nodes.description: Fetches a single page's metadata and property values by id (a database row is a page).

page_id.description: The id of the page (or database row) to retrieve. Resolve via notion_search.

nodes.name: notion_list_users
nodes.title: List Users
nodes.description: Lists the people and bots in the workspace, returning each user's id, name, and type.

page_size.description: How many users to return per page (1–100). Defaults to 100.

start_cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous call's next_cursor to fetch the next page.
